authorization: The owner explicitly approved all six proposed learning improvements, one for one. Standing paired repository and existing-plugin update authorization applies.
goal: Teach through observed practice, graduated support, evidence of independence, retrieval, causal feedback and one evolving learning project.
changes: Use a short diagnostic learner attempt inside the first lesson, with optional skipping and no extra onboarding.
Graduate and fade assistance while honoring requests for examples or full explanation.
Record criterion-specific evidence and supported, independent familiar-task or independent new-context performance.
Revisit earlier skills through one brief retrieval or transfer task in a relevant learning session.
Distinguish craft, instruction, reference, generator and tool causes; unsupported causes remain Unknown.
Build one evolving project with linked exercises and separate new-context tasks.

allowed_sections.skills/workflow-orchestrator/SKILL.md: Learning-method navigation only; startup blocks and metadata unchanged
allowed_sections.skills/workflow-orchestrator/references/: Teaching cycle, diagnostic practice, assistance, assessment, retrieval, diagnosis, project work and evidence
allowed_sections.skills/workflow-orchestrator/assets/lear: Optional practice evidence and recovery fields
allowed_sections.scripts/validate-learning-mode.mjs: Learning-practice guards and expanded case inventory
allowed_sections.tests/learning-mode.test.mjs: Focused teaching-contract regressions and case count
allowed_sections.tests/studio.test.mjs: Expanded learning and total case counts only

protected: One onboarding question per turn and six-question ceiling
37 owner identities, metadata, starters, assets and pinned sources
Existing project locks, creation route and shared QA budget
Existing eval cases and all historical reports
Plugin identity and private personal audience
acceptance: All six methods are reachable from the existing learning owner
Evidence and assistance survive a portable handoff without automatic persistence
No fabricated independent performance or learning outcomes
One guarded paired update and readback from the same source
execution_budget: Local checks and bounded source-use tests; no paid providers, media generation or private learner data
rollback: Revert only this patch on the current source and publish a guarded versioned correction; preserve later edits
evidence_boundary: Source tests and isolated source-use tests are distinct from active-client behavior and measured educational effectiveness.
